text: The owned rename changes the assertion operand to exchangeServer but still supplies no assertion-message argument. The adjacent comment does not state an expected result in the failure diagnostic. The deliberate review rule requires a nonempty message at this changed assertion; a suitable proposed message is The server should implement IExchangeIncomingServer. This is a local diagnostic finding, not a missing-should-only defect, a new automatic rule or a reproduced query-interface failure.
title: The renamed Exchange fetch assertion has a comment but no diagnostic message
